TITLE: Iran Update Special Report, May 17, 2026
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 19:25 UTC
AUTHOR: Stefaniia Bern (ISW/CTP)

KEY TAKEAWAYS:
1. US and Iran continue to pursue fundamentally incompatible negotiating positions.

2. Likely Iranian or Iranian-backed forces launched three drones targeting Barakah Nuclear Power Plant in Abu Dhabi UAE on May 17.
   - 2 intercepted by air defences; 1 hit electrical generator causing fire
   - UAE MoD: drones came from "the western border"
   - Iran has previously used drones to approach from unexpected direction to obscure responsibility (Abqaiq 2019 — drones fired from Iranian territory but approached from west)
   - IRGC-affiliated media attempting to blame Saudi Arabia (Tasnim, Defa Press)
   - Iran has previously launched attacks on UAE to drive wedge between UAE and other Gulf states

US-IRAN NEGOTIATING POSITIONS:
- Fars News Agency (IRGC-affiliated): US laid out 5 main conditions in response to Iranian counterproposal
  - Reject war reparations
  - Require Iran transfer 400 kg uranium to US
  - Limit Iran to 1 operational nuclear facility
  - Refuse to release more than 25% frozen Iranian assets
  - No guarantees against future US/Israeli attacks
- Iran sent counterproposal May 10; Trump called it "totally unacceptable"
- IRGC Major General Jafari (May 11): Iran will not negotiate until US accepts terms including end to war on "all fronts", lifting sanctions, releasing frozen assets, compensation, recognition of Iran sovereignty over Strait of Hormuz

MARITIME:
- CENTCOM (May 17): 81 commercial vessels redirected, 4 disabled since Apr 13 blockade

INTERNAL:
- Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf becomes Iran's special representative for PRC affairs
- Approved by Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei after President Pezeshkian proposal
- Differs from previous PRC representative roles in "level of authority"

IRAQ OUTPOSTS (NYT May 17):
- Israel built TWO clandestine outposts in Iraqi desert in late 2024
- 1st near al Nukhayb, Anbar Province (already reported May 9)
- Used for air support, refueling, "medical treatment" during 12-day June 2025 war
- IDF deployed commando + search-and-rescue teams there before May 2026 campaign — to recover Israeli pilots if Iranian forces shot down jets
- 1st outpost no longer operational
- 2 Iraqi officials (incl Hassan Fadaam, senior Wisdom Movement) to NYT: second undisclosed Israeli outpost exists, location/status unspecified
- US "compelled" Iraq to shut down radars to protect US aircraft during 12-day war + recent conflict
